requirement: Update a suspected cause: the target and the new pathogen must exist and be live, the new (pathogen, severity, treatment site) tuple must not be held by another live cause, then map the new values, save, and report Updated.

preconditions.text: A live suspected cause exists for the target id
The requested pathogen exists and is live
No other live cause holds the requested tuple
Another live cause already holds the requested tuple
The target or the pathogen is missing, soft-deleted, or unknown

inputs.text: Update to a tuple already held by another live cause
Move the cause to a different pathogen
Update whose tuple is held only by a soft-deleted cause
Update request with an unknown cause id
Update request referencing a soft-deleted pathogen
Same tuple applied to another pathogen
Update request for a cause that was soft deleted beforehand
Update the severity and treatment site of a live cause
Update request with an unknown pathogen id

returns.text: Success with Updated status; the new tuple is persisted and UpdatedAt refreshed
Failure with BadRequest when the cause or pathogen is missing, deleted, or unknown
Failure with BadRequest when another live cause holds the requested tuple
Uniqueness only considers live causes, so a soft-deleted duplicate does not block

exception_text: No unhandled exception; every rejection is returned as a failed Result
